reviewNotes: Gwoza's other peoples (Mafa, Guduf, Waha, Wandala, Marghi and more) are not yet mapped separately.
name: Lamang (Gwoza)

summary.text: The Lamang were foothill people of the western Gwoza hills and now live mostly on the plains beside them. Udosen treats Lamang and 'Gwoza' as the same language.
